title: AC1021 empty LayerStates root candidate and projection blockers

observed_graph.l_control_extension: one source-bound DICTIONARY owned by LAYER_CONTROL
observed_graph.layerstates_target: one source-bound empty DICTIONARY with the extension dictionary as parent and reactor
observed_graph.companion_targets: two empty source-bound DICTIONARY records, one for each other root
observed_graph.evidence: LibreDWG 0.14 minJSON identifies the three root names and handles. The local libdxfrw typed import and source-frame check in the opt-in adapter harness confirmed the AC1021 versions, DICTIONARY types, parent/reactor roles, empty bodies, and unique source identities before the projection attempt.

whole_source.result: strict output refused before file creation

experiments: The existing broad test projection retains unrelated FIELD/FIELDLIST carriers and production export refuses at 'FIELD/FIELDLIST carriers have no qualified DXF serializer'.

A narrower experiment retained only the four source-bound LayerStates dictionaries and the ACAD_SCALELIST dictionary/SCALE records, cleared unrelated XRECORDs and source-frame receipts, and kept only STANDARD DIMSTYLE/TEXTSTYLE rows. It passed the FIELD/FIELDLIST gate but failed at BLOCK_RECORD planning callbacks because the test projection lacks a bounded source BLOCK_RECORD/BLOCK graph. No output/readback was produced.
selected_projection.decision: Do not admit the AC1021 LayerStates profile. A future projection must include a dependency-closed block-record graph and prove same-writer retry plus fresh ASCII/Binary readback while retaining strict full-source refusal.

alternate_sample.result: same three-root extension and empty LayerStates child observed, but libdxfrw reports one object parse failure; strict output is therefore ineligible

decision: Do not broaden the AC1021 LayerStates production admission yet. Build a test-only projection that closes and verifies only the selected LayerStates graph and its required table/NOD dependencies, preserve strict whole-source refusal, then prove atomic failure/retry and fresh ASCII/Binary readback. Neither candidate drawing is copied into the repository. No support claim is promoted.
